statement: For every genuine Boolean f on three address bits and arbitrary data bits, if every nonzero conditional row inclusion marginal is at least beta>0, then H(f)<=4 I_A(f)+(8+h2(beta)/beta) I_Y(f). In particular fair/frozen row marginals imply H(f)<=10 I(f).
remaining_gap: Replace the minimum row-marginal beta by a Boolean-coupled address/granularity payment without reusing the complete-label charge; then remove the general-k exponential label loss.
